content: TMDB API v3: discover/movie endpoint supports filtering by genre (with_genres) and watch provider (with_watch_providers + watch_region); /movie/{id}/watch/providers returns per-region flatrate/rent/buy data sourced from JustWatch. Official rate limiting was removed in 2019 but CDN caps around 50 req/s; best practice is server-side caching of genre lists and watch-provider results (they change infrequently) rather than per-request calls, plus exponential backoff on 429.
